        self.name = name
        self.category = category
        self.price = price

                  'min_price': filters.get('min_price', 0), 
                  'max_price': filters.get('max_price', float('inf'))}
        
        response = requests.get(base_url, params=params, headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {api_key}'})

        if response.status_code == 200:
            products = [Product(**product) for product in response.json()]
            return products
        else:
            raise Exception(f'Failed to fetch products: {response.text}')
